topic: Shanks intercepted Kaidou a full day before the Summit War of Marineford even started
title: Shanks Stopped Marineford One Day Before It Started
description: A full day before the Summit War of Marineford even began, Shanks had already made the move that decided how it would end. Here's the Kaidou interception almost nobody talks about. Was it loyalty, or was it positioning?
comment: Did Shanks engineer the whole war's outcome in advance, or did he just get lucky Kaidou backed off? Pick one.

lines.text: Shanks stopped the Marineford war a full day before it even started.

lines.text: The day before the fighting, Kaidou tried to cut off Whitebeard's path to Marineford.

lines.text: Nobody knows what happened in that fight. We only know Kaidou backed off.

lines.text: Think about what that actually means.
